subject: Startups
title: At-Will Employment
description: A micro-lesson that makes At-Will Employment usable.

hook.text: In most US states, you can fire someone for any reason—or no reason at all. That's at-will employment.

buildup.text: At-will means either party can end the relationship at any time. No cause needed. But there are exceptions.

discovery.text: You still can't fire someone for discriminatory reasons: race, gender, religion, age, disability, or retaliation.

twist.text: Wrongful termination lawsuits are expensive even when the company wins.

climax.text: Smart startups document performance issues, give warnings, and create paper trails—even in at-will states.

punchline.text: At-will is freedom. Documentation is protection.

quiz.question: What is at-will employment?
options: Employees can only work when they want
Either party can end the job at any time without cause
